content: Library table stakes across shadcn/ui, Chakra, Mantine, Ark UI: dark mode as first-class (CSS variables or theme object), WAI-ARIA accessibility with keyboard nav and focus management tested against assistive tech, SSR/Next.js compatibility, tree-shaking (per-component files + sideEffects false), full TypeScript types. shadcn theming = CSS variable swap via class=dark on root. Ark UI is Zag.js state-machine based, framework-agnostic (React/Vue/Solid/Svelte), 45+ components. Mantine: 120+ components, ~70 hooks, structured token theme object.
